7129.title: Installation discovery invokes diagnostics
7129.rootCauseOneLine: Update discovery starts a diagnostic subprocess to obtain channel and installer metadata; compatibility-only discovery skips it.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — mechanism addressed; policy tradeoffs need review
prReviews.topFinding: Removing diagnostic metadata changes channel-specific update eligibility and nonstandard native update actions.

7129.proposedFix: Use passive channel/installer metadata, or explicitly approve conservative unknown-channel and installer-ownership behavior before removing diagnostics.
7129.caveats: Dispatch only; real authentication effects unverified. Same agent repeated two clean runs. Full build and one ancillary discovery test had unrelated baseline failures. Reproduction source and exact focused logs are inline, per reports repository policy. No automatic fix because the update-policy decision gate failed.
